bom_recipes_component_xor.name: bom_recipes_component_xor
bom_recipes_component_xor.value: ("bom_recipes"."component_type" = 'RAW_MATERIAL' and "bom_recipes"."raw_material_id" is not null and "bom_recipes"."component_menu_item_id" is null) or ("bom_recipes"."component_type" = 'SEMI_FG' and "bom_recipes"."component_menu_item_id" is not null and "bom_recipes"."raw_material_id" is null and "bom_recipes"."component_menu_item_id" <> "bom_recipes"."menu_item_id")

stock_batches_location_xor.name: stock_batches_location_xor
stock_batches_location_xor.value: ("stock_batches"."branch_id" is not null) <> ("stock_batches"."warehouse_id" is not null)

stock_batches_expiry_valid.name: stock_batches_expiry_valid
stock_batches_expiry_valid.value: ("stock_batches"."expiry_status" = 'UNKNOWN') or ("stock_batches"."expiry_status" = 'DATED' and "stock_batches"."expiry_date" is not null) or ("stock_batches"."expiry_status" = 'NON_EXPIRING' and "stock_batches"."expiry_date" is null)

expenses_void_audit.name: expenses_void_audit
expenses_void_audit.value: ("branch_expenses"."status" = 'POSTED' and "branch_expenses"."void_reason" is null and "branch_expenses"."voided_by_id" is null and "branch_expenses"."voided_at" is null) or ("branch_expenses"."status" = 'VOID' and "branch_expenses"."void_reason" is not null and length(trim("branch_expenses"."void_reason")) >= 3 and "branch_expenses"."voided_by_id" is not null and "branch_expenses"."voided_at" is not null)

leave_approval_pay.name: leave_approval_pay
leave_approval_pay.value: ("workforce_leaves"."status"='APPROVED' and "workforce_leaves"."pay_type" is not null) or ("workforce_leaves"."status"<>'APPROVED' and "workforce_leaves"."pay_type" is null)

stock_movements_exactly_one_item_ref.name: stock_movements_exactly_one_item_ref
stock_movements_exactly_one_item_ref.value: ("stock_movements"."item_type" = 'RAW_MATERIAL' AND "stock_movements"."raw_material_id" IS NOT NULL AND "stock_movements"."menu_item_id" IS NULL) OR ("stock_movements"."item_type" = 'SEMI_FG' AND "stock_movements"."menu_item_id" IS NOT NULL AND "stock_movements"."raw_material_id" IS NULL)

stock_counts_submit_fields.name: stock_counts_submit_fields
stock_counts_submit_fields.value: ("stock_counts"."status" = 'DRAFT' AND "stock_counts"."submitted_by_id" IS NULL AND "stock_counts"."submitted_at" IS NULL) OR ("stock_counts"."status" != 'DRAFT')

stock_counts_approve_fields.name: stock_counts_approve_fields
stock_counts_approve_fields.value: ("stock_counts"."status" IN ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED') AND "stock_counts"."approved_by_id" IS NOT NULL AND "stock_counts"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("stock_counts"."status" IN ('DRAFT', 'SUBMITTED'))

cutting_yield_deviations_review_pairing.name: cutting_yield_deviations_review_pairing
cutting_yield_deviations_review_pairing.value: ("cutting_yield_deviations"."reviewed_by_id" is null) = ("cutting_yield_deviations"."reviewed_at" is null) and ("cutting_yield_deviations"."reviewed_by_id" is null) = ("cutting_yield_deviations"."review_reason" is null)

internal_requisition_lines_type_xor.name: internal_requisition_lines_type_xor
internal_requisition_lines_type_xor.value: ("internal_requisition_lines"."line_type" = 'RAW' and "internal_requisition_lines"."raw_material_id" is not null and "internal_requisition_lines"."menu_item_id" is null) or ("internal_requisition_lines"."line_type" = 'PREPARED' and "internal_requisition_lines"."menu_item_id" is not null and "internal_requisition_lines"."raw_material_id" is null)
